scripts._comment:test: NODE_ENV is pinned: a shell that exports NODE_ENV=production makes Vite resolve React to its production build, from which Testing Library's act() is stripped, and 28 of these tests then fail with a message that blames the code. vite.config.ts pins it as well for anybody who runs vitest directly.
scripts._comment:pretest: The browser tests run against dist, which `build:release` deliberately builds without the harness — so an e2e run after a release build silently tested an app with no fixture in it, and every test timed out waiting for a row. Building first is cheap and removes the trap.
scripts._comment:test:ui: No list of spec files here, on purpose: there was one, and materials.spec.ts — the guard on the kit's material numbers — sat outside it for a whole session, so the gate stayed green while the guard never ran. playwright.config.ts already ignores perf/architecture.spec.ts, which test:perf runs. This way a new spec under tests/ is in the gate the moment it exists.
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:ui && npm run test:perf
